title: Recurring Transactions for bStocks Now Available on Binance Convert
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. bStocks are offered through an Approved Prospectus in the ADGM and are not offered in any other jurisdiction. bStocks are Tokenized Securities issued by BTech Holdings Limited, a Binance group affiliate. bStocks are classified as Certificates representing certain Financial Instruments, paragraph 92, Schedule 1 to FSMR. bStocks represent an interest in underlying securities held by the Issuer and are not direct ownership of the underlying Shares. bStocks do not allow holders to directly own a share or stock in the underlying listed company. Fellow Binancians, Binance is pleased to announce that eligible users can now set up  recurring transactions for bStocks  on  Binance Convert , making it easier to automate bStock purchases at your preferred schedule. With bStock recurring transactions, users can automate purchases of supported bStocks from as little as  0.01 USDC equivalent , access fractional exposure to supported US shares through tokenized securities, and build bStock exposure over time. bStocks are tokenized securities each backed 1:1 by a US share held at a regulated custodian. bStocks are the first tokenized securities admitted to the  FSRA Official List , issued under an FSRA-approved Prospectus and traded on a Recognised Investment Exchange. Automate bStock Purchases on Binance Convert Eligible users can now: Set recurring bStock purchases : Automate purchases of supported bStocks at a preferred frequency. Start small from just 0.01 USDC equivalent : Access fractional US stock exposure from as little as 0.01 USDC. Build exposure over time : Set up a recurring plan to purchase supported bStocks automatically. Trade 24/7 on Binance Convert : Access supported bStocks at any time, subject to product and market availability. Access tokenized securities backed by real shares : bStocks are backed 1:1 by underlying shares held at a regulated custodian. How to Set Up Recurring bStock Transactions via Binance Convert Your available entry point may vary depending on your country or region of residence, verification status, and product availability. On the Binance App (available for app version iOS:3.16.3 and Android: 3.15.7): On Homepage, tap  [Trade] , then  [Convert] or [Buy/Sell] . Select  [Recurring]  mode. Search for your preferred supported bStock. Enter the purchase amount and choose your preferred frequency. Review the details and confirm your recurring plan. Start your bStocks journey with recurring transactions from just  0.01 USDC equivalent , alongside millions of Binance users.  Stay tuned for an  upcoming promotion  where eligible users can set up recurring bStock transactions and share rewards! Note:  There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support!
